summary: Legacy VB6 application with critical modernization risks. High technical debt in data access patterns, authentication gaps, and mixed technology stack complexity.

hotspots.reason: Direct ADO usage without abstraction, potential SQL injection vulnerabilities
frmLogin form without visible security framework integration
Multiple transaction forms without visible audit trail or rollback mechanisms
Wildcard imports reduce code clarity and increase coupling

risks.title: Data Contract Preservation Risk
risks.description: Legacy VB6 forms may contain undocumented business rules and data validation logic that could be lost during modernization

risks.title: Authentication Security Gap
risks.description: No visible modern authentication framework integration in legacy application

risks.title: Database Schema Unknown
risks.description: Database structure and relationships not visible in provided artifacts

risks.title: Transaction Integrity Risk
risks.description: Banking transactions without visible ACID compliance or audit mechanisms
